education.title: How I got here.
education.body_01: Peer-to-peer learning, project-based pedagogy. Three years of C, algorithms, system programming, networking, and graphics — no courses, no teachers, no classes.
education.body_02: IAE Lille, University School of Management. Digital strategy, intercultural management, branding, international copyright. Two years of alternance + a 5-month internship along the way.
education.title_03: CPGE BL, Notre Dame de la Paix
education.body_03: French preparatory class for the Grandes Écoles — Hypokhâgne / Khâgne. Economics, sociology, history, geography, literature, mathematics, English. The work-ethic foundation everything else sits on.

skills.title: What I reach for.
skills.hard_lede: A self-portrait in seven axes — plotted by years on the tool, depth into its dark corners, and how often it's the first thing I open in the morning.
skills.proj_lede: Seven projects — four 42 school exercises in C/C++ and three personal Next.js builds. Peer-reviewed, written from scratch, no shortcuts.
skills.soft_lede: Carried over from years in marketing and project management. The bits that don't fit on a tech stack list.
skills.soft_01_desc: Building trust with clients, partners and teams through clear communication and alignment.
skills.soft_02_desc: Thriving in fast-changing environments — picking up new technologies and contexts quickly.
skills.soft_03_desc: Planning, executing and shipping projects on time using agile, pragmatic methodologies.
skills.soft_04_desc: Staying calm under pressure, finding root causes, and getting to a fix fast.
